detailSections.title: Data Security & Encryption
detailSections.description: Your data never leaves your control. Every byte is encrypted, isolated, and protected with enterprise-grade security from training to deployment.

features.title: End-to-End Encryption
features.description: Data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) option with secure key rotation and zero-knowledge architecture for sensitive data.

features.title: Data Isolation
features.description: Tenant-specific data segregation with private cloud deployment options. Virtual private cloud (VPC) support and dedicated infrastructure for enterprise clients.

features.title: Secure Model Training
features.description: Training data never leaves your environment. Differential privacy for sensitive datasets, federated learning capabilities, and model encryption with secure storage.

detailSections.title: Access Control & Identity
detailSections.description: Granular permission management that scales with your organization. Control who can access what, when, and how with enterprise SSO integration.

features.title: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Granular permission management with pre-built enterprise roles (Admin, Developer, Analyst, Viewer). Custom role creation and attribute-based access control (ABAC) support.

features.title: Enterprise SSO Integration
features.description: SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 support with Active Directory / LDAP integration. Compatible with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace with multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforcement.

features.title: Agent-Level Security
features.description: Per-agent access policies with API key management and rotation. Rate limiting, throttling, and IP whitelisting for production agents ensure secure operations.

detailSections.title: Compliance & Governance
detailSections.description: Built to meet global regulatory requirements. Deploy AI confidently knowing you're compliant from day one with comprehensive audit trails.

features.title: Regulatory Compliance
features.description: GDPR compliance built-in with data subject rights and right to deletion. HIPAA-ready for healthcare, SOC 2-ready infrastructure, plus CCPA, PIPEDA, and LGPD support.

features.title: Data Governance
features.description: Complete data lineage tracking from source to model to output. Automated PII detection and redaction, retention policies, and data residency controls for EU, US, India, and GCC regions.

features.title: Audit Trails & Reporting
features.description: Complete activity logs tracking who accessed what and when. Automated compliance reports (quarterly, annual) with real-time monitoring dashboards and exportable logs for external audits.

detailSections.title: AI-Specific Security
detailSections.description: Protection against AI-specific threats. From prompt injection to model extraction, comprehensive security for your AI operations.

features.title: Prompt Injection Protection
features.description: Built-in input validation with malicious prompt detection. Sanitization of user inputs and context-aware filtering to prevent prompt injection attacks.

features.title: Model Security
features.description: Protection against model extraction attacks with watermarking for proprietary models. Adversarial robustness testing and secure model versioning with rollback capabilities.

features.title: Output Monitoring
features.description: Real-time hallucination detection with bias and toxicity monitoring. Sensitive data leak prevention and content policy enforcement for safe AI outputs.
